setup.title: Practice

mc.0: Wrong options come from any language.
mc.1: Wrong options come from the same language.
mc.2: Wrong options come from the same language and word type.
mc.3: Wrong options are other forms of the same word.

hints.modeDifferent: You see a word in one language. You answer in another language.
hints.modeSame: A grammar exercise inside one language, for example the gender of a word.
hints.wordOrder: "Weakest first" shows the forms you know least.
hints.mcNeedsChoices: Only used when the answer style shows choices.
hints.mcNeedsDifferent: Only used for exercises in different languages.
hints.tiNeedsTyping: Only used when you type the answer.
hints.noExercisesYet: Adjectives and adverbs have no exercises yet.
hints.singleLanguageAccount: Your account has one language. "Different languages" is not possible.
hints.modeMixed: Mixed shows translations between languages and grammar exercises.
hints.posPreselected: With selected words, only their word types can be chosen. Adjectives and adverbs have no exercises yet.
hints.preselectedNoExercises: None of the selected words has a word type with exercises yet. Remove the pre-selection to practice your other words.

preselected.note: We will change this word list in a later update.

confirm.title: Remove the pre-selection?
confirm.body: Practice will use all your words, not only the selected ones.

validation.languagesMinTwo: Select at least two languages, or choose "Same language".
validation.partsOfSpeechRequired: Select at least one word type.
validation.amountPositive: Use a number of 1 or more.
validation.amountTooLarge: Use a number of 100 or less.

noWords.title: No words to practice yet
noWords.body: Add a word with at least two languages and exercises appear here.

noMatch.title: No exercises found
noMatch.reasonFewWords: There are not enough words with these word types or languages.
noMatch.reasonMissingForms: The words do not have the forms that these exercises need.
noMatch.hint: Change the settings and try again.
noMatch.reasonMode: The mode leaves nothing to ask, for example "Same language" with only one language selected.

error.title: The exercises could not be created

setup.subtitle: Short sessions from your words
setup.fixToStart: Fix the highlighted fields to start.

leaveDialog.title: Leave this session?
leaveDialog.body: Your answers so far stay saved. Save the session to continue it later, or delete it.
leaveDialog.limitNote: You can keep up to {{max}} saved sessions for {{days}} days. A new session replaces the oldest one.
leaveDialog.savedToast: Session saved. You can resume it from the set-up screen.

session.answerAll: Answer all exercises to see the results.

task.Gender: What is the gender of this word?
task.Short-Form: What is the short form of this word?
task.Regularity: Is this verb regular or irregular?
task.Gerund: What is the gerund of this verb?
task.Participle: What is the participle of this verb?
task.Auxiliary-Verb: Which auxiliary verb does this verb use?

feedback.partialHint: Only accents or capital letters are different. It counts as correct.

actions.masterTip: I know this. Show it less. This applies to all forms of this word in {{language}}.
actions.reviseTip: I find this difficult. Show it more. This applies to all forms of this word in {{language}}.

toast.mastered: Marked as mastered — this translation will show up less.
toast.revise: Added to Revise — it shows up more until 5 correct answers.

master.title: Mark the {{language}} translation as mastered?
master.body: All forms of this word in {{language}} — not just this form — will be shown less often. You can remove this any time.

revise.title: Add the {{language}} translation to Revise?
revise.body: All forms of this word in {{language}} — not just this form — will be shown more often. It clears automatically after 5 correct answers.

dialogs.failed: The status did not change. Try again.

removeMastered.title: Remove “Mastered”?
removeMastered.body: All forms of this word in {{language}} will show up at their normal rate again.

removeRevise.title: Stop revising?
removeRevise.body: All forms of this word in {{language}} return to their normal schedule.

results.title: Session results
results.almostHint: includes {{count}} almost correct — accents or capitals only

configs.title: Saved configurations
configs.empty: You have no saved configurations. Set the options in the settings panel, then select "Save configuration".
configs.listError: The saved configurations could not be loaded.
configs.missingWords: Some words of this configuration are not available now.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameTaken: You already have a configuration with this name.

sessions.title: Ongoing sessions
sessions.note: You can keep up to {{max}} sessions for {{days}} days. A new session replaces the oldest one.
sessions.empty: You have no saved sessions. Leave a session and select "Save session and leave" to keep it.
sessions.listError: The saved sessions could not be loaded.
sessions.gone: This session is not available now. It may have expired.

replaceDialog.title: Replace your unfinished session?
replaceDialog.body: You have an unfinished session in this tab. If you resume the saved session, the unfinished session is lost.

apiErrors.invalidPartsOfSpeech: Select at least one word type.
apiErrors.invalidAmount: Use a whole number from 1 to 100.
apiErrors.invalidSettings: One of the settings is not valid.
apiErrors.invalidWordIds: The selected words are not valid.
apiErrors.notFound: This word or form was not found.

apiErrors.invalidDescription: The description can have at most 200 characters.
apiErrors.nameTaken: You already have a configuration with this name.
